headline: Opera introduces WebAI standard for local AI in browsers
summary: Opera introduced a new web standard called WebAI, designed to work with a variety of AI models and let users deploy AI locally in their browser. Citing the standard, Opera said it will start shipping local AI models with its flagship browser.
